notes.content: Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major. Although it is not a requirement of the major, the department recommends students take an introductory statistics course as part of their undergraduate work. Introductory statistics serves as a prerequisite for ENVS 120, an upper-division major requirement. Other introductory statistics courses can be considered as a substitute. In rare circumstances, instructor permission can be obtained to enter the course without the prerequisite. For more information, please visit: Department of Environmental Studies .
